OBJECT DETECTION AND ALERT GENERATION

The software supports various both video and image input formats and utilizes bounding boxes to identify and label detected objects by their corresponding class names. Additionally, it offers filters to specifically target certain objects and can generate text alerts along with relevant screenshots of specific frames. These alerts can be sent to remote servers to serve as intruder warnings.
